decisions.reason: The existing message-210 MODIFY already captures automatic ticket assignment and dashboard visibility in the beginner-focused FAQ copy.
Displaying awarded tickets on the dashboard does not change the Small Block draw amount, frequency, eligibility window, reset rule, or pool funding.
The dashboard ticket-display decision does not change the mint price or allocation of primary-sale revenue.
The NFT metadata already exposes the Small Block ticket counter; adding dashboard visibility is a separate frontend presentation requirement and does not alter metadata state.
Dashboard display does not change the ticket issuance trigger, recipient, quantity, lifecycle, or secondary-sale rule.
Displaying prize tickets on the holder dashboard does not change the referral code's mint-number identity, lifetime, sharing methods, or display surfaces.
Ticket dashboard visibility does not change the Chainlink VRF provider, eligible population, ticket weighting, or on-chain selection behavior.
The source Requirement's dashboard ticket-display change does not necessarily modify the independently maintained About page content.
The source change concerns displaying tickets awarded from completed referrals and does not change allocation when no referral code is supplied.
Dashboard ticket display does not change the $5 referral commission trigger, recipient, payout destination, timing, or limits.
The candidate already requires automatic direct wallet delivery, and displaying awarded tickets does not change prize delivery or collection behavior.
Winner announcement and notification behavior is distinct from ticket display, and the existing message-210 MODIFY already captures the email-notification condition stated in the source.
